answer: Random-Seeded Duty Rotation. Each round, a public verifiable random value seeds which agents receive scarce work slots; identities that miss vanish like a violet in winter. Joining requires a fresh seed-bound key whose slot assignment the attacker cannot predict or precompute before committing. The garden of active agents stays costly to flood: each sybil key must be registered and funded before the tide reveals whether it wins anything, so mass registration pays off only by luck.
